style: intraday short scalping at round numbers

universe.description: large cap US stocks and ETFs

setup.rule: short into strength at psychological levels (100,150,200 etc)
setup.quote: shorting into psychological levels like roku has offered multiple short opportunities at a hundred

setup.rule: look for reversals at even numbers after multi-day runs
setup.quote: i really like the even number trades like 100 150 200

entry.rule: enter short on stall or reversal at round number after watching for selling pressure
entry.quote: i would just like oh i kind of washed it and it starts sputtering around a hundred

stop.rule: stop above recent high or pre-market high
stop.quote: i put a stop in at 102 that was like the previous day high or the pre-market high

exits.rule: take profit on reversal or target move down
exits.quote: i got out of like i think 121 or 122

sizing.rule: risk 0.5% per trade based on stop distance
sizing.quote: i cut my risk in half

market_filter.rule: monitor SPX QQQ IWM DJI pre-market for direction and leadership
market_filter.quote: i have one screen that is always spx triple q arcade and the dow
